status: Locally verified unreleased source; not published or deployed
scope: Pinned pathlib and ntpath over the existing Rust filesystem and R2 owner; lazy original PathLike/walk helpers and native permission/link/timestamp operations.

nativeOperations.chmod: Path modes 0..0777 with current write authority; no-follow and directory-fd options fail ENOTSUP.
nativeOperations.link: Current write authority; follow_symlinks reaches the existing canonical inode owner.
nativeOperations.symlink: Relative UTF-8 target text is preserved; unsupported Windows and directory-fd options fail explicitly. Empty or oversized targets fail through Python OSError.
nativeOperations.utime: Current write authority; exact unsigned 64-bit nanoseconds or split seconds/fraction conversion; omitted timestamps use one acquired native Effect clock value; follow_symlinks is honored before one conditional R2 head publication.
nativeOperations.bounds: Native path and target validation exposes ENAMETOOLONG before an oversized request can fail the driver Schema boundary.
nativeOperations.PathLike: Unchanged pinned ABC and GenericAlias semantics, registered as os.PathLike lazily.
nativeOperations.walk: Unchanged pinned generator with top/bottom ordering, pruning, bytes, link traversal and error callbacks; native DirEntry.is_junction is false for this POSIX-only filesystem.

stdlib.loading: The os helpers are loaded on first attribute request; a native regression verifies ordinary programs do not import them eagerly.

coverage: Native Alchemy workerd service binding and local R2; no filesystem mocks.
Path lexical POSIX/Windows operations, abstract/generic/path-like protocol, text/binary I/O, recursive mkdir, glob/rglob and preserved metadata copy.
Relative symlinks, hard links, link no-follow behavior, namespace errors, rename/replace and file/tree copy/move.
Partial iterdir and walk generators, buffered readers, module identity and moved cwd after closing the original Worker and restoring in a new one.
Current readonly grants deny chmod/touch/utime/links/writes without namespace or timestamp changes; native execute-only protocol objects cannot make fresh filesystem reads.
Write+execute authority without read successfully changes permissions/timestamps and creates both link kinds; full authority reads back exact metadata, target text and shared inode identity.
Retained context execution requires read authority; the execute-only request is rejected by the actual transport with 403.
Default software rejects the added permission/timestamp/hardlink/symlink mutations with EROFS before the existing corruption/replacement checks.
Timestamp integer/fraction range/type validation, exact uint64 boundary, bytes, NUL and oversized UTF-8 paths.
Path.move failure preserves its source and missing destination parent, matching the CPython oracle.

PathLikeDependency.observed: Initial pinned pathlib import reached the missing os.PathLike declaration.

fractionalTimestamp.observed: Direct multiplication of epoch seconds lost fractional nanoseconds; the native comparison now matches 1700000001125000000.

oversizedPaths.observed: Oversized path failed the host request boundary instead of returning a catchable Python OSError.

missingEXDEV.observed: Path.move to a missing parent raised NameError because errno.EXDEV was absent; the central native catalog now provides it.

bootstrapObservation.scope: Native metered Wasm in Bun: construction, filesystem bootstrap and one expression. Deterministic fuel and linear-memory capacity only; not workerd timing, total Worker memory, production CPU or billing.

bootstrapLimits: Four fresh ABBA samples with a 100,000,000-fuel bootstrap ceiling and 512 memory pages. Initial native construction is already bounded separately from user instruction fuel; these counts do not imply that a normal expression needs the same user budget. This is not a production CPU or latency distribution.
upgrade: Python native binary changes require explicit reset of existing Python contexts. Other four Wasm engines are byte-identical to 0.29.0; filesystem v6 and checkpoint format stay unchanged. No archive has been published or deployment performed for this source.
limits: Complete AgentOS parity and comparative production CPU, latency, cost and aggregate isolate-memory admission remain open.
Directory descriptors, special mode bits, chmod no-follow, Windows link flags and pre-epoch timestamps are unsupported.
URI helpers, pathlib.types/typing, complete stdlib/pip, all errno/POSIX attributes and arbitrary-crash/cross-build heap recovery remain open.
Unfrozen optional platform-module import probes still require current read authority; no stubs or swallowed permission failures were added.
All feature programs retain actual instruction, memory, host-call, filesystem and output limits; no global policy ceiling was raised.
Publication, source/tag CI, production binding proofs and actual local/production Minutei validation are separate next gates.
